[Amazon Rainforest, Ecuador] Timelapse video of a sunset over the Amazon River, shot by my husband

In 2013, myself, my husband and two friends took a trip to Ecuador. We spent half our time in Quito and in the Andes Mountains, and the other half in the Amazon Rainforest (that said, there will be more posts about this trip to come).

You might say I have a thing for sunrises and sunsets. Something about them attracts me, and so I insisted that my husband use his gear to take a video of the sunset over the Amazon River.

The view is from our camp. It was shot using photography, a photo every 2 minutes, I think, and all the photos were put together so you can watch the sun set in 1.5 minutes.

It was very beautiful out there, so remote, so far from others. I'm glad we have this video to remind us of its tranquility.
Very beautiful, I can imagine feeling very small when surrounded by nature of such scale.

It was amazing. And it is so different than any nature I've encountered. The animals do not fear people, there, because they don't come across people too often. So you would see bugs that have literally no fear of being crushed, so they don't fly away. The silence is strange. But awesome, too. Peaceful. Again unlike anything I've experienced.
